skip_reason: The proof is purely algebraic/proportional, dealing with commensurability of magnitudes, area application, and classification of apotomes (sixth apotome). No geometric configuration claims are made — no point positions, ray orderings, angle decompositions, or inside/outside claims. All reasoning operates on magnitude relations and the taxonomy of irrational lines in Book 10.
